personalInfo.statement: My name is Matthew but I often go by Matt, I am currently a sophomore in school and I am using the GI bill to attend. I am a Computer Science major looking to get my degree here in a year and a half. My concentration is Cyber Security as I am fascinated by it and hope to learn all that I can.
personalInfo.personalBackground: I traveled a bit throughout my youth, I was born in Minnesota before moving down to Las Vegas, eventually ending up and settling in North Carolina about three years ago.
personalInfo.professionalBackground: I served in the Military for five and a half years, I currently attend school using the GI bill.
personalInfo.academicBackground: I am currently in my second year at University of North Carolina, my major is Computer Science with a concentration in Cyber Security.
personalInfo.primaryWorkComputer: Custom-built desktop computer running Windows 10 (64-bit), with an AMD Ryzen 7 3700X processor.
personalInfo.alternateComputerLocation: I have an ACER laptop and an Alienware laptop that I can take with me to work wherever I want. There is a coffee shop I frequent called Not Just Coffee that I often get work done at.

courses.reasonForTaking: I have little experience with developing working applications at this time and took this class to get more experience with it.
I took this class because I have an interest with Cyber Security as it is my concentration.
I took this class because my major required it.

quote: You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough.
